description: The data of a screen.changed event: a watched area starts to change. The event text names the area.

event.description: The watch event: change, stable, clipboard, bell, or resize.

area.description: The name of the area. "screen" when no area is set.

rect.description: The area in reference pixels (the screen size at the first connect).

changed_pct.description: The percent of the area pixels that changed.

changed_px.description: The number of pixels that changed.

bbox.description: The bounds of the changed pixels, in reference pixels.
